review.notes:
TwinKeys Remote is a remote control for TwinKeys, a free, open-source Mac app for theatre and concert sound operators (source and downloads: https://github.com/kajisho5/ableton-twinkeys). It controls Ableton Live on a main Mac and a backup Mac at the same time, over the local network only.

IMPORTANT: the app needs a Mac to do anything.
- It works only with a Mac running TwinKeys 2.2 or later and Ableton Live 11 or 12, on the same local network as the iPhone or iPad.
- WITHOUT A MAC: tap "Try with sample data" on the first screen. Every screen then works with fictional sample data, "· Sample" is shown in the top bar, and nothing is sent anywhere. The Apple Watch app shows the same sample data. To leave, open Settings and tap "End the sample and connect to a Mac".
- One Mac is enough to try every screen. The backup Mac is optional.
- There is no account and no sign-in.

Setup (about 10 minutes):
1. On a Mac with Ableton Live 11 or 12, download TwinKeys (notarized) from https://github.com/kajisho5/ableton-twinkeys/releases/latest, open it and allow Local Network access.
2. In TwinKeys Settings > Live, click "Install into Live". Restart Live. In Live's Settings > Link, Tempo & MIDI, choose "TwinKeysBridge" in a free Control Surface slot. TwinKeys Settings then shows "Live: Connected".
3. In TwinKeys Settings > Pairing Code, click "Make New Code" and note the 10-character code.
4. In TwinKeys Settings, turn on "Allow TwinKeys Remote to connect".
5. In TwinKeys Remote, type the same code and tap Save. Allow Local Network access. Tap "Connect" next to the Mac.
6. The iPhone and the Mac show the same 4 digits. Click "Allow" on the Mac.

Screens: Session (clip grid: launch clips and scenes), Mixer (volume, pan, mute, solo, sends), Cues (the Mac's cue keys), GO (launches the scene selected in Live and selects the next one), Settings (show lock and what it stops, 0 dB fader cap, privacy policy and support links).
Apple Watch app: GO, choose scene and All Notes Off. It talks only to the iPhone app (WatchConnectivity), never to the Macs.
Full guide: https://kajisho5.github.io/ableton-twinkeys/guide/#controlling-live-from-an-iphone-or-ipad-twinkeys-remote

Network and privacy: the app connects only to TwinKeys on the user's own Macs (Bonjour service _twinkeys-remote._tcp, then TCP). It does not connect to the internet and collects no data. The connection is encrypted with Apple CryptoKit.

TwinKeys is an unofficial tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by Ableton. "Ableton" and "Live" are named only to say which software it works with.

en-US.name: TwinKeys Remote
en-US.subtitle: Show cue remote for two Macs
en-US.description:
TwinKeys Remote is a remote control for sound operators who run a show on two Macs: a main Mac and a backup Mac, both playing the same Ableton Live set. Every tap on your iPhone or iPad reaches Live on both Macs at the same time, so the backup is always ready to take over.

TwinKeys Remote works together with TwinKeys, a free Mac app (macOS 13 or later). Install TwinKeys on both Macs first. Without it, TwinKeys Remote cannot do anything.

SCREENS
• Session: the clip grid. Tap a clip to launch it, tap an empty slot to stop that track, or launch a whole scene. Playing clips show the time left.
• Mixer: volume, pan, mute, solo, and Send A / Send B. Drag anywhere in a column. A dashed line marks 0 dB.
• Cues: the same cue keys as on the main Mac, each showing what it does (the memo written on the Mac), plus the last cue and whether it reached the backup.
• GO: Live's scene list becomes your script. The big GO launches the selected scene on both Macs and moves on. Back and Next only choose; they never play.
• Settings: show safety options and the connection.
• Apple Watch: GO, choose scene and All Notes Off, through the iPhone.

MADE FOR THE SHOW
• Top bar: link status, delay to the backup, play, stop, tempo, position and All Notes Off.
• Show lock: freezes tempo and the mixer. You can also lock launches, stops and cues. GO and All Notes Off are never locked.
• Stop and Stop all clips need a long press.
• Faders can be kept at 0 dB or below.
• A warning appears when the backup Mac has a different set open.
• If the main Mac stops, switch to the backup Mac from the iPhone (hold 1 second to confirm).
• Landscape first on iPhone. On iPad the screens spread into two or three columns.

SAFE CONNECTION
• Works only on your local network. No internet connection and no account needed.
• Your iPhone needs the same pairing code as your Macs, and you allow it once on the Mac after checking a 4-digit code.
• All traffic is encrypted.

WHAT YOU NEED
• Two Macs with TwinKeys 2.2 or later (free)
• Ableton Live 11 or 12 on both Macs, with the TwinKeysBridge control surface (TwinKeys installs it for you)
• An iPhone or iPad with iOS 17 or later, on the same network as the Macs; watchOS 10 or later for the Apple Watch

No Mac yet? Tap "Try with sample data" on the first screen to try the screens with made-up data.

PRIVACY
TwinKeys Remote collects no data. No accounts, no analytics, no ads, no in-app purchases.

TwinKeys Remote is made by Shogo Kajiyama / SEVENTHWELL. Its source code is open on GitHub (MIT License).

TwinKeys is an unofficial tool. It is not made, endorsed or supported by Ableton. Ableton and Live are trademarks of Ableton AG.
en-US.promotionalText: Fire clips, scenes and cues in Ableton Live on a main and a backup Mac at once. New: GO runs your show from Live's scene list with one big button.
en-US.whatsNew:
• Apple Watch app: GO, choose scene and All Notes Off.
• If the main Mac stops, switch to the backup Mac from the iPhone.
• The backup Mac confirms each action also ran in its Live, and you are told when it did not.
• Choose what the show lock stops. GO and All Notes Off are never stopped.
• "Try with sample data" lets you try the screens without a Mac.
• Privacy policy and support links in Settings.
Needs TwinKeys 2.2 on both Macs.

ja.name: TwinKeys Remote
ja.subtitle: 2台の Mac を同時に操作する本番リモコン
ja.description:
TwinKeys Remote は、2台の Mac（メインとバックアップ）で同じ Ableton Live のセットを動かして本番をする、音響オペレーターのためのリモコンです。iPhone・iPad で押した操作が、2台の Live に同時に届きます。メインの Mac が止まっても、バックアップがすぐに代われます。

TwinKeys Remote は、無料の Mac アプリ「TwinKeys」（macOS 13 以降）と組み合わせて使います。先に両方の Mac に TwinKeys を入れてください。TwinKeys がないと、このアプリだけでは何もできません。

■ 画面
・セッション：クリップのます目。押すとクリップを再生、空いたます目でそのトラックを停止、シーンごとの再生もできます。再生中のクリップには残り時間が出ます。
・ミキサー：音量、パン、ミュート、ソロ、Send A・Send B。列のどこをなぞっても動きます。点線が 0 dB です。
・キュー：メインの Mac のキューのキーと同じボタン。何をするか（Mac で書いたメモ）が大きく出ます。直前のキューと、バックアップに届いたかも分かります。
・GO：Live のシーンの並びを台本として使います。大きな「GO」で、選んでいるシーンを2台で再生して、次へ進みます。「前へ」「次へ」は選ぶだけで、鳴らしません。
・設定：本番の安全のための設定と、接続の状態。
・Apple Watch：GO、シーンを選ぶ、オールノートオフ。iPhone を通して動きます。

■ 本番のために
・上の帯に、つながりの状態、バックアップまでの遅れ、再生、停止、テンポ、位置、オールノートオフ。
・本番ロック：テンポとミキサーを動かなくします。止めるもの（クリップ・シーンの再生、停止、キュー）は選べます。GO とオールノートオフは止めません。
・「停止」と「全クリップ停止」は長押しで動きます。
・フェーダーを 0 dB より上げないようにできます。
・2台で違うセットを開いていると、警告が出ます。
・メインの Mac が止まったら、iPhone からバックアップの Mac に切り替えられます（1秒長押しで確認）。
・iPhone は横向きが基本です。iPad では画面が2列・3列に広がります。

■ 安全なつながり
・使うのは手元のネットワークだけです。インターネットとアカウントは要りません。
・iPhone には Mac と同じ合言葉を入れ、Mac で4桁の番号を確かめて、一度だけ許可します。
・通信はすべて暗号化しています。

■ 用意するもの
・TwinKeys 2.2 以降を入れた Mac 2台（TwinKeys は無料）
・両方の Mac に Ableton Live 11 か 12 と、Live 用の部品 TwinKeysBridge（TwinKeys から入れられます）
・iOS 17 以降の iPhone・iPad（Mac と同じネットワークにつなぎます）。Apple Watch は watchOS 10 以降

Mac がなくても、最初の画面の「サンプルで試す」で、架空のデータで画面を試せます。

■ プライバシー
データを一切集めません。アカウント、利用状況の分析、広告、アプリ内課金はありません。

TwinKeys Remote は Shogo Kajiyama / SEVENTHWELL が作っています。ソースコードは GitHub で公開しています（MIT License）。

TwinKeys は非公式のツールです。Ableton 社が作ったり、認めたり、サポートしたりしているものではありません。Ableton、Live は Ableton AG の商標です。
